Research and stream checks: 13 October 2026. Editorial synthesis by Tony’s Guide; no new fieldwork or class classification of the recorded speakers. Adaptations of Farquharson’s APiCS survey and Irvine-Sobers’s open book are credited under CC BY 4.0. Other research is paraphrased within the consulted material’s scope. Full archival streams are supplied by the Smithsonian; links do not imply permission to republish copies. Archive catalogue metadata was checked against its XML finding aid. MP3 responses and decoding were checked; heard playback, exact excerpt times and each speaker’s degree of microphone-related self-monitoring have not been verified. No fabricated transcripts or voice imitations are supplied.
